《智能体规范应用与创新发展实施意见》印发: "Implementation Opinion on Normative Application and Innovation Development of Intelligent Agents" Issued
本报北京5月8日电 （记者金歆）记者8日从国家网信办获悉：近日，国家网信办、国: Beijing, May 8 (Xinhua)—(Reporter Jin Xin) The reporter learned on May 8 from the Cyberspace Administration of China that the Cyberspace Administration of China, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology jointly issued the "Implementation Opinion on Normative Application and Innovation Development of Intelligent Agents," aiming to implement the State Council's "Opinion on Deeply Implementing the 'Artificial Intelligence+' Action" and promote the normative application and innovation development of intelligent agents.
实施意见提出，智能体是具备自主感知、记忆、决策、交互与执行能力的智能系统，是人工: The implementation opinion proposes that intelligent agents are intelligent systems with autonomous perception, memory, decision-making, interaction, and execution capabilities, and are an important form of artificial intelligence products and services.
随着大模型等新一代人工智能技术迅猛发展，智能体正加速与网络空间、物理世界深度融合: With the rapid development of new-generation artificial intelligence technologies such as large models, intelligent agents are accelerating deep integration with cyberspace and the physical world, profoundly changing human production and living patterns and social governance models.
实施意见明确，智能体发展要坚持安全可控、规范有序、创新驱动、应用牵引的基本原则，: The implementation opinion clarifies that the development of intelligent agents should adhere to the basic principles of safety and controllability, normative and orderly development, innovation-driven approach, and application-oriented guidance, and proposes four aspects of measures: first, strengthening the development foundation, improving the technological foundation, and establishing standards and protocols.

近期，我国一些科技公司相继推出自研智能体: Recently, some Chinese technology companies have successively launched independently developed intelligent agents.
它精准契合了大众对人工智能的期待：从一个只会聊天的机器人，进化为解决实际问题的助: It precisely meets public expectations for artificial intelligence: evolving from a chatbot that only knows how to chat into an assistant that solves practical problems.

它的运行逻辑清晰易懂：用户通过微信等社交工具输入指令，系统调用大模型的理解能力，: Its operating logic is clear and easy to understand: users input instructions through social tools such as WeChat, the system invokes the large model's comprehension capabilities, judges user intent, breaks down task steps, and finally converts instructions into concrete operations such as clicking the mouse and reading/writing files.
同时，智能体还能记住用户习惯和偏好，实现“千人千面”的个性化体验: At the same time, intelligent agents can remember user habits and preferences, achieving "one-thousand-people-one-thousand-faces" personalized experience.

二是作为“手脚”的技能插件持续丰富，极大拓展了智能体的执行能力: Second, skill plugins serving as "hands and feet" continue to be enriched, greatly expanding the execution capabilities of intelligent agents.
但也要看到，新一代智能体仍处于快速演进过程中，底层架构尚未成熟稳定，在实际中暴露: However, it should also be noted that the new generation of intelligent agents is still undergoing rapid evolution, with immature and unstable underlying architecture, exposing problems such as technological instability and high computing power costs in practice.

人工智能时代，立住人的主体性（文思）: In the age of artificial intelligence, uphold human subjectivity （Wensi）
我查了下这一周手机里的各种信息，有一二十条有关AI（人工智能）的信息，平均一天差: I checked the various information in my phone this week, finding twenty or so messages about AI (artificial intelligence), averaging about three per day.
对于AI领域的核心技术，呈万箭齐发态势的各类大模型，在人文领域，我们听见两种不同: Regarding core technologies in the AI field, with various large models presenting a myriad of arrows all launching at once, in the humanities realm, we hear two different voices.
一种是大模型有用吗: One is: are large models useful?
还有一种是，大模型确实太了不得，无所不能，因此副作用也随之而来：学生不用学习了，: There is another: large models are indeed remarkable and capable of anything, therefore side effects follow: students no longer need to study, teachers find it difficult to teach.
这是两种相反的认识，但奏响的都是唱衰大模型和AI的乐章: These are two opposite views, but both sing a tune of dismissing large models and AI.
首先，大模型没那么弱，觉得它没用，很大的原因可能是你没有掌握使用的技巧，没下过正: First, large models are not that weak; if you feel they are useless, a major reason may be that you have not mastered the techniques of using them, have not undergone proper training, or have not used truly powerful large models.
其次，大模型确实也没强到绝杀万物、唯我独尊，至少它不会比人聪明，何以见得: Second, large models are indeed not so powerful as to be omnipotent and supremely dominant; at least they are not smarter than humans—how do we know this?
最近密集的AI信息中，最耸人听闻的一篇题目是“课堂已死”: Among the dense AI information recently, the most sensational article is titled "The Classroom is Dead."
就是说，有了大模型，学生不用学习了，凡事依赖大模型，大模型成了懒人宝典: That is to say, with large models, students no longer need to study; they rely on large models for everything, making large models a lazy person's handbook.
有了大模型，教师没法教了，因为教不过大模型: With large models, teachers cannot teach, because they cannot teach better than large models.
学生为什么不能利用它，为什么用大模型就叫不爱学习，甚至叫不学习: Why can't students utilize them? Why does using large models count as not loving to learn, or even not studying at all?
当然有，大模型时代之前就有，这怨不得大模型: Of course there are such issues; they existed before the large model era and cannot be blamed on large models.
所以为那些已经开始为自己的饭碗担忧的同行们提一个建设性思路，大模型如果能倒逼着我: So I propose a constructive perspective for colleagues who have begun to worry about their livelihoods: if large models can spur us to commit to self-improvement, reshape ourselves into newer versions, and regain our students' affection, isn't that a good thing?
倒是在自我与AI间，如何认识和处理两者的关系，是关键: Rather, how to understand and handle the relationship between oneself and AI is key.
有一种观点，认为AI技术带来了非专业和专业的知识平权: There is a viewpoint that AI technology has brought knowledge equality between non-professionals and professionals.
他说大部分领域，顶级专家使用AI的杠杆价值，远远高于普通人使用AI: He says that in most fields, the leverage value of top experts using AI far exceeds that of ordinary people using AI.
指望AI抹平专业差距，纯属做梦: Expecting AI to level the professional gap is purely wishful thinking.
非AI时代，普通人和顶级专家的差距是100倍，AI时代，这个差距可能会扩大到1万: In the non-AI era, the gap between ordinary people and top experts is 100-fold; in the AI era, this gap may expand to 10,000-fold.
AI和Agent（智能体）会成为一面放大镜，把人与人之间专业能力的差距，放大给人: AI and Agent (intelligent agents) will become a magnifying glass, amplifying and revealing the professional capability gaps between individuals.
确实，很多人以为，有了AI，大家就站在同一起跑线上了，专业不专业无所谓了，反正A: Indeed, many people think that with AI, everyone stands on the same starting line, and professionalism is irrelevant since AI can help everyone complete tasks anyway.
对于学生来说，AI能帮你写作，也能帮别人写作，所以，你能不能向它提出别人提不出的: For students, AI can help you write, but it can also help others write; therefore, whether you can ask it questions that others cannot, have it produce something different from what others ask it to produce, detect its errors when it makes mistakes, judge whether it writes well, and use what it generates to conduct truly valuable research is crucial—and all of this depends entirely on your own professional foundation.
这些东西，AI给不了你，只能靠你自己一页一页、一本一本地读书、思考和积累: These things AI cannot give you; you can only rely on yourself to read books, think, and accumulate knowledge page by page and book by book.
对于教师来说同样，假设你真的是有专业水准的学者，而且你依然在持续致力于专业水准的: The same applies to teachers: if you truly are a scholar of professional caliber, and you continue to dedicate yourself to constantly improving your professional standards, while also being a teacher with thoughts, emotions, warmth, and cultivation, displaying taste and personal charm in every gesture and expression, how can AI possibly replace you?
也许我们还可以这样说，AI是放大器，放大的是你已经拥有的东西: Perhaps we could also say this way: AI is an amplifier that amplifies what you already possess.
你的专业越扎实，你使用AI才越像老虎添上了翅膀，AI在你手里的杠杆就越长: The more solid your professional expertise, the more AI is like giving a tiger wings, and the longer the lever AI becomes in your hands.
没有这个底子，AI不过是帮你更快地生产出一堆看起来像模像样、实则一无可取的东西: Without this foundation, AI is merely helping you produce more quickly a pile of things that look decent on the surface but are actually worthless.
我们很幸运，赶上了AI这个科技加速时代带给我们的利器，我们不拥抱它不利用它是不明: We are fortunate to have caught up with AI, this sharp tool brought to us by an era of accelerated technological advancement. It would be unwise for us not to embrace and leverage it.
